cands.name: Hilary Holley
cands.bio: Republican; House member since March 24, 2026 after a special election. University of Florida ag-education graduate; Florida FFA Foundation executive director since 2021; former aide to Denise Grimsley, Adam Putnam and Jimmy Patronis. Lives on a ranch in Polk City.

record.text: Won the March 2026 special election for HD 51 with about 55% over Democrat Edwin Perez, succeeding term-limited Rep. Josie Tomkow.

money_notes.text: For the special election she raised over $122,000 plus about $134,000 in in-kind help from the House Republicans' campaign arm and the Republican Party of Florida.

endorsements.text: Wilton Simpson, Denise Grimsley, Neil Combee, Josie Tomkow and the Florida Chamber (per Florida Politics headlines).

cands.gaps: Short record (took office March 2026). No controversies found. Biography from Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hilary_Holley). Owner sources: only alexjoneslive.com on-site search was run for this name (no results); stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com on-site searches are bot-blocked and the web-search budget ran out, so those were not checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
